verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official MCP server that exposes its tavily-search and tavily-extract tools. The docs say it works with Cursor, Claude Desktop and any MCP client, and a probe confirmed the MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, setup and configuration details in the evidence, and evidence that MCP covers the crawl, map and research tools beyond search and extract.
